import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder

# Load the dataset with proper header parsing
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', sep='\t', header=0)

# Calculate the proportion of gardening-introduced plants
invaded_niche['prop_gard'] = invaded_niche['n.gard'] / invaded_niche['n.total']

# Drop rows with missing values
invaded_niche = invaded_niche.dropna()

# One-hot encode the 'habitat' column
encoder = OneHotEncoder()
encoded_habitat = encoder.fit_transform(invaded_niche[['habitat']])
encoded_habitat_df = pd.DataFrame(encoded_habitat.toarray(), columns=encoder.get_feature_names_out(['habitat']))

# Concatenate the encoded habitat features with the original dataset
invaded_niche = pd.concat([invaded_niche, encoded_habitat_df], axis=1).drop('habitat', axis=1)

# Perform correlation analysis
correlation_matrix = invaded_niche.corr()
correlation_matrix['prop_gard']
